name: Islamic Scholarship Fund (ISF)
mission: The Islamic Scholarship Fund's (ISF) mission is to increase American Muslim representation in media and policy by providing access and funding through academic scholarships, internships, fellowships, film grants, and mentorship.
theoryOfChange: By empowering students and young professionals to pursue degrees and careers in media and policy-related fields, ISF has continued to develop an impressive alumni base who work as journalists, policy analysts, filmmakers, and advocates, and are all committed to changing perceptions of Islam and Muslims. Thus, we believe that through our programs, we provide monetary support in addition to professional and moral support, and can increase the number of students who can go on to counteract problematic narratives and policies to help create a more inclusive United States.

In FY2024, the organization generated <cite id="3">$1,922,887 in total revenue</cite> to expand opportunities for young professionals in public-facing fields [3]. The organization holds an <cite id="1">overall score of 91.7/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> [1]. However, its core initiatives continue to build long-term institutional presence, demonstrating a <cite id="5">100% graduation rate among alumni</cite> with <cite id="5">88% working in their chosen fields</cite> [5].
